messages:
ravi (pm): Quick idea: introduce a lightweight "compatibility shim" for model migrations that can be toggled per-tenant. Purpose: reduce customer-visible regressions during catalog swaps. Draft below.
ana (eng): Can you sketch what the shim does? Is it a prompt adapter, post-processing filter, or routing wrapper?
ravi (pm): All of the above as options. Core concept: when swapping model A->B, shim can 1) apply prompt-preserving transformations, 2) run policy-based post-filters to align outputs, 3) route fallback calls to A when confidence low. Configurable per-tenant.
lena (sre): Ops constraints: shim must be cheap (no large extra compute path per token). Prefer a small ensemble scorer or lightweight embedding similarity check to decide fallback. Keep per-tenant CPU/GPU budget limits.
omar (support): From support: need clear customer toggle and an "analytics diff" showing sample outputs before enabling. Also provide easy revert in console.
paul (sales): Customers will love safer migrations. Suggest we offer shim as beta for enterprise with free migration credits. Need to clarify SLA implications.
nana (eng): Implementation sketch: shim module with strategies: - prompt_transform: ruleset (trim, temperature normalize) - output_align: few-shot post-processing templates - fallback_router: similarity scorer (embed cos) with threshold. Small YAML example: 
```
compat_shim:
  enabled: true
  strategies:
    - prompt_transform
    - fallback_router
  fallback_threshold: 0.82
  cost_budget: 0.05  # extra cost tolerance per request
```
ravi (pm): Default behavior: disabled. For migrations, product can enable shim for 30d per-tenant. Pinned customers auto-exempt unless they opt-in.
lena (sre): Monitoring: track shim_hit_rate, fallback_rate, eval_delta_on_shim, latency_overhead. Auto-disable shim if latency overhead > 10% or fallback_rate > 15%.
omar (support): Support playbook: how to explain shim to customers: one-liner: "a safety layer that keeps behavior consistent while we update models". Also include troubleshooting steps: disable shim, adjust threshold, submit sample prompts.
ci-bot: created job: `compat-shim-run 6112345678 --model from:alpha -> to:beta --policy shim_v1` :gear:
ravi (pm): Decision items: approve default thresholds (fallback_threshold 0.82, latency overhead 10%), confirm trial length (30d), and pricing/incentive (sales). If OK, we'll pilot on 3 willing customers next sprint.
nana (eng): I'll prototype the scorer and post perf numbers by Thu.
lena (sre): I'll add shim metrics to the rollout dashboard and create alerts for overhead.
paul (sales): I'll line up pilot customers and draft commercial note.
omar (support): I'll prepare canned responses and the disable flow.
ravi (pm): Thanks all 44d closing thread; will post pilot checklist once pages are ready."
